name: What is an ADU and how is it different from a regular garage conversion?

mainEntity.name: What is an ADU and how is it different from a regular garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: An Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) is a secondary housing unit on a single-family residential lot. While a garage conversion might simply transform the space into a new room, an ADU conversion creates a complete, independent living space with its own kitchen, bathroom, and sleeping area. This distinction is crucial for understanding zoning requirements, permits, and the potential for rental income or multi-generational living.
acceptedAnswer.description: An ADU is a complete, independent living unit with kitchen, bath, and sleeping area, unlike a simple garage conversion which just adds a room.
